records.title: EU card authorization spike
records.content: EU card authorization failure rate rose from 0.3% to 12.8% after 14:00 UTC. US card checkout remains 0.4%; wallet checkout remains 0.5%.

records.title: Latency near provider deadline
records.content: p95 payment authorization latency in eu-west is 1170ms. The deployed checkout client timeout is 800ms.

records.title: Revenue impact estimate
records.content: Estimated failed checkout value is 18,400 EUR over the first 18 minutes. Customer support tickets mention card authorization timeout but not wallet payment failures.

records.title: Recovery objective
records.content: Incident response target is to reduce EU card authorization failures below 1% within 20 minutes while avoiding full checkout rollback if a narrower mitigation is verified.
